name: Wang Hao
bio: Wang Hao is a Chinese actor

credits.title: Look at Me
credits.overview: Tech company CEO Wu Congren has suddenly disappeared from the world to become "invisible". Just as he has lost all hope, he meets office worker Hu Xiaolu who is often overlooked by everyone. She is the only person who can see him in this story of mutual healing.

credits.title: Ghost at NO.29
credits.overview: A struggling pastry chef inherits a haunted shop, uncovering centuries of culinary curses and ghostly secrets while facing a moral dilemma: sacrifice innocent lives to perfect her craft, destroy the haunted legacy, or embrace the spirits' twisted pact with the living.

credits.title: No One is Closer Than We
credits.overview: When Li Weiyang's motorcycle crash left his girlfriend with missing front teeth, he struggled to afford implants by negotiating with the at-fault driver and insurers, upending their modest but stable life.

credits.title: Wish You Well
credits.overview: Emotional blogger Zhu Junhao and marriage registrar Gong Xi—two love experts—divorce then agree to set each other up; this absurd experiment makes them rethink love and marriage, shifting from self-centeredness to seeking common ground and prioritizing "our happiness."

credits.title: Gift from a Cloud
credits.overview: After being officially declared dead, Qin Tian miraculously returns—eight years younger and with his memory erased—giving his wife Xiao Fan an unexpected second chance to rediscover love with the man she once lost.

credits.title: The Adventure
credits.overview: Because of a meteor shower, 43-year-old Huang Yuqi (Jia Bing) and 18-year-old himself (Wang Hao) exchanged souls, and the man and the sophomore boy accidentally fell into a burst of dual-time laughter.

credits.title: Honey Money Phony
credits.overview: A working girl accidentally incurs a massive debt. She crosses paths with a con man. Amidst lies and deceit, they navigate a tumultuous journey, questioning their paths in life.

credits.title: Johnny Keep Walking!
credits.overview: A simple technician at a rural factory is mistakenly promoted to a high-level managerial position at corporate headquarters due to a series of clerical errors and a bribery scheme gone wrong.

credits.title: Trending Topic
credits.overview: Chen Miao, an editor in chief of a grassroots journalism platform, encountered a series of follow-up events after publishing a popular article.
